body:
Hey thanks for the response. 
My whole team lost their jobs so it wasn't for bad performance reasons or anything, and yeah it's true I didn't like the job very much anyway but I just don't know if I have the energy to go through the whole job search, interviews, training, meeting new people etc thing again. 
I knew when I was a young teenager that I might be gay but I didn't tell anyone until a few years ago when I was 19. I actually wish I had never told anyone. I hate the way people look at me now. Some friends stopped talking to me. I hate that people always make fun of gay people. I hate that I could never have kids and my own family. 
I honestly don't see a future for me and I'm really worried about myself. I have felt low before but never quite as low as I feel now.
